channel.title: Lacquer — CoProducer Journal
channel.description: Twenty essays on loudness, true peak, repair, stems, ScrewAI, and local .bat workflows.

item.title: Why streaming platforms turn loud masters down
item.description: They normalize toward −14 LUFS. A hotter bounce is turned down, not rewarded.

item.title: True peak is what codecs clip
item.description: Sample peak can look legal while AAC reconstructs an overshoot. Aim ≤ −1.0 dBTP.

item.title: What a 70-to-90 repair actually changes
item.description: Crazy Stacy 70→90, BeatGoHard 77→95, Drippin 66→93. Delivery pass, not a remix.

item.title: Should you upload an unreleased master?
item.description: Only if you accept a vendor holding the file. Metering can stay local.

item.title: A release checklist that matches the meter
item.description: Six gates: LUFS, true peak, clips, sample rate, phase, score ≥ 90.
